request.title: Prove five refutations in Ch05 Sec3b_Printed (Example 5.3.3.1, Prop. 5.3.3.4(1), Lemma 5.3.4.2(2), Prop. 5.3.4.5(2))
request.body:
Proves five refutations in `RiemannMasullo/Ch05_ThetaZSpaces/Sec3b_Printed.lean`. Only proofs and `private theorem` helpers placed directly above the theorems they serve are added, plus `import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Gaussian.PoissonSummation`. No statements changed.

Closes #4812
Closes #4815
Closes #4817
Closes #4818
Closes #4819

**What the counterexamples are**
- `Printed.positiveRealExponentialDecay_valueDecay_false` (Example 5.3.3.1, p. 249): I = {0} and f(x) = exp(−x²) sin(exp(2x²)). f is smooth and |x|^k |f(x)| → 0 at infinity, but f is not a Schwartz function. At the points x = √(log(2πn)/2) its derivative is 4x·exp(x²) ≥ 4x, so the derivative is unbounded. The docstring uses I = ℝ; the printed claim quantifies over every I, so I = {0} is enough.
- `Printed.realArchimedeanMellin_monomial_false` (Prop. 5.3.3.4(1), p. 258): n = 1, ε = 0, f an even ContDiffBump at 0 (instead of the Gaussian). The odd profile is 0, so the right side is 0 on Re s > −1. At every real σ > 1 the even Mellin integral is a positive real number, so the two sides differ at points arbitrarily close to 1. That contradicts eventual equality in `codiscrete ℂ` (`nhdsNE_le_codiscrete`).
- `Printed.sLocalRestriction_surjective_false` (Lemma 5.3.4.2(2), proof, p. 260): ℚ with S = ∅. The local unit −1 at the real place is the diagonal S-unit −1 (`sIdeleQuotient_mk_eq_one`), so every S-local quasi-character restricts to 1 there. The sign character x/|x| takes the value −1 at −1, so it is not a restriction.
- `Printed.sLocalIdelicZFunction_principalValue_has_poles_false` (Prop. 5.3.4.5(2), p. 264): ℚ, S = ∅, trivial character, s = 0. The pole multiplicity is positive because the Euler factor is Γℝ. The test is f = 0, whose Z-function is identically 0: the uniqueness in `sLocalIdelicZetaIntegral_exists_continuation` forces this. Its order at 0 is ⊤, not negative. (The docstring's bump also works, but the zero test is enough for the statement as written.)
- `Printed.sLocalArchimedeanPoleMultiplicity_eq_sum_false` (Prop. 5.3.4.5(2), p. 264): ℚ, S = ∅, trivial character, s = 0. ℚ has a single infinite place, so the sum is the order of Γℝ at 0. That order is negative, so it equals no natural number.

**Checks**
- `lake build RiemannMasullo.Ch05_ThetaZSpaces.Sec3b_Printed`: passes. The only `sorry` warnings left are for the three refutations not attempted here (#4813, #4814, #4816).
- Full `lake build`: passes (14 min after the module build).
- `scripts/lint.sh`: ok.
- Statement signatures: `lake env lean --run scripts/Signatures.lean RiemannMasullo.Ch05_ThetaZSpaces.Sec3b_Printed` on the file before and after this change, then `scripts/signatures.sh --compare`. The two lists are identical.
- `#print axioms`:
  - `positiveRealExponentialDecay_valueDecay_false`, `sLocalRestriction_surjective_false`, `sLocalArchimedeanPoleMultiplicity_eq_sum_false`: `[propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]`
  - `realArchimedeanMellin_monomial_false`, `sLocalIdelicZFunction_principalValue_has_poles_false`: `[propext, sorryAx, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]`. The `sorryAx` comes from upstream declarations that are still open: `realArchimedeanMellin_existsUnique` in the first case, the S-local Z-function and principal-value chain (Ch03 §3, Ch05 §3a) in the second.
